description: The chart of a query ends with its span. matches of r over the captured A sees no longer y, although y → A B continues past the span in the text. So the omission of [T] is permitted, and matches holds (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x(A) B
%conditions matches($x, r)
%rule r y [++T]
%rule y A | A B
